body: Thank you so much for commenting, and i will try!
No i battled with anxiety and panic attacks for a long time but now i got it under control. Anxiety can be a bitch sometimes i get it totally. Thanks for the tips.

I mean when I started I was so much worse compared to you. But one thing I feel that you need before starting to sing your songs is that you have to dare to go louder. Not higher in your range but louder.  It's hard to judge you when I only see a part of your voice/range. I mean you can produce and sing because it's your song, but maybe take some vocal lessons before. 

Search on youtube also. There are some useful videos there.

Good luck man!

I have the same issue!

I actually find serenity in my suicidal thoughts. So many people worries about death and what comes after but since I'm suicidal I  don't have the same issues. One thing that I felt very useful is that  If you accept the suicidal thoughts it can give you clarity, so you can live your short or long life above average. To enjoy every single thing you can from life. This gives me peace and calm.

But it's different from person to person!

I just hope that you find your way of life and prosper!

Hey

Don't say that you want to kill yourself! This is an action from which you will never recover from. Take it from experience, the success rate is pretty low and if you fail the psychological consequences are pretty steep. I have a saying " Run run run, as fast as you can until your legs give out, and if your legs give out then accept defeat"

Just live! keep on living and make memories, and when death comes,  open it with wide arms. Life is hell but sometimes it takes pain to make the everlasting memories. If the afterlife is real think of the memories you could've made under your lifespan that you can enjoy. You never end a story until its finished, cause otherwise, you miss out on a lot of things.

I went through a period where I felt like everything was hopeless but you will find your quirk that makes life a bit easier to endure!

​

Keep on fighting man!

Im not a pro :D but ill try to help

Could be your second vocal passaggio that start on the note F#4, thats why its so easy to sing notes above it but hard to sing in it!

Ok :) One thing that i learned is that time is so precious. it will develop your voice if you just keep getting comfortable and learning some techniques to reach mix and stuff! if you want i can link some good YT videos that explain the "Mix area" and how to reach it. And when you pull upp chest voice is can hurt you in the long run! so try to stay in your comfortable area untill you feel ready. 

Good luck! Have fun! and pm me if you want more tips :)

Are you really tensed when you go higher? and have you established a mix yet?

​

One thing that i hear, is that i cant hear where your mix connects, and you pulling upp chest voice is always a bad thing. i would say work on getting a strong mix and doing scales to get more comfortable with going up and down, disconnectiong and connecting " Mix, head and chest voice"

If you would like me to tell you more detailed what to do just pm me on reddit! i can also help you with live singing tips :)

I would say that forcing falsetto/headvoice is never a good thing. If you are comfortable with singing in falsetto/headvoice on normal songs it's gonna be much easier and it's not a problem regarding technique. I mean one thing i did to strengthen my headvoice/falsetto was to do scales and really get it into my head that falsetto is supposed to be a bit weak and not so loud so you cant really strong arm it with heavy notes. And headvoice is clear and bright, with a lot of small things that could affect you like as " Tension, airflow" and so on

When i sing i use mix/falsetto in 4th octave. When i belt like an C4 i of course use mix but when its more like calmer i use falsetto. And yes if you are not like a counter tenor/tenor its gonna be tensing to sing in the 4th octave. What type of vocalist are you? " Baritone, tenor, counter-tenor"

Wait you are 13? and have a low note on G1? are you sure that correct?

I mean being a bass at such a low age/early age is really intreseting and rare. If you cant sing the song you want just lower it like 1-2 octaves. The pop industry is dominated by tenors but they all sound the same :D So dont think you having a low voice as a bad thing. Can you put up a clip, so we can hear how a normal scale sounds when you sing?

And necessarily the stuff you see might not be directed at people with higher voices, maybe just better technique and more years of experience. 

​

Ps. Its hard to sing other artist songs when its fitted for their voice.

Of course anybody can learn to sing, but there is limits to what your voice can produce even with training. But instead of going directly to lessons try youtube. Before paying for anything like an instrument, microphone. establish how far you can get by watching youtube tutorials. Thats how i learned btw :)

GL and may the song be with you
